key_concepts: Agents such as man, plants, animals, wind, temperature, and water break down rocks
Chemical weathering and mechanical weathering are two kinds of weathering
Erosion can be identified by visible evidence and its cause
Flowing water carries topsoil from higher to lower areas
Erosion can expose denser rocks and pebbles in soil
Dry soil breaks into smaller particles easily
Terracing uses steps on slopes to slow water and reduce soil loss
Contour plowing is a soil conservation method
Strip cropping plants different crops in strips across a slope
Riprapping uses arranged stones on slope edges to control erosion
Reforestation replaces cut trees to help conserve soil
Continuous land use without rest harms soil
